title: Detecting Benchmark Contamination Through Watermarking
authors_zh: Tom Sander, Pierre Fernandez, Saeed Mahloujifar, Alain Durmus, Chuan Guo
paper_type_zh: 基准污染检测与评测可靠性审计论文
best_for_zh: 在发布前设计可审计基准、且可访问待测模型权重的维护者。
one_line: Proactive benchmark watermarking produces a calibrated white-box test for memorized contamination.
发布前给基准题目加秘密水印，并用有确定假阳性率的白盒统计检验发现模型是否记住该基准。
why: It makes benchmark contamination auditable before release without relying on a clean reference set.
inclusion_reason: The central contribution provides a proactive audit mechanism for benchmark contamination and evaluation reliability.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Benchmark scores can be inflated when test questions enter pre-training data, yet post-hoc membership tests require an uncontaminated reference set and cannot reliably establish that training occurred. The result is that an observed score may conflate capability with memorization.

The paper proposes a proactive audit surface: before release, a provider rephrases benchmark questions with a secret text watermark. A white-box statistical test then looks for the watermark's learned “radioactivity” in a suspect model. Its unit of evaluation is a watermarked question and the model's next-token predictions, not a newly released training dataset.

基准题目混入预训练语料会抬高分数，但事后成员推断需要未污染的同分布参照集，难以可靠证明模型是否见过测试集。因此，观察到的提升可能来自能力，也可能只是记忆。

论文把审计前移：发布前用带秘密文本水印的模型改写题目；评测时，在可访问权重的嫌疑模型中检验水印留下的“放射性”信号。其评测对象是带水印的问题及模型的下一词预测，而不是新发布的训练数据集。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The contribution is a benchmark-release protocol that couples watermark-preserving rephrasing with a calibrated contamination test. A keyed red/green-list watermark biases question wording without intentionally changing answers; the later test replays the key and asks whether the suspect model preferentially predicts green-list tokens. The resulting binomial-test p-value has a defined false-positive rate for the narrower claim that the model memorized the watermark.

The paper releases code in Meta's meta-seal repository, but it does not present a separately packaged benchmark dataset, a license, or a universal detector for closed models. Its essential data object is the provider-held watermarked benchmark plus its secret key.

核心贡献是一套基准发布协议：先以尽量保持效用的方式改写题目并嵌入水印，再以校准的统计检验审计污染。密钥控制的绿/红词表水印改变题目措辞而不刻意改变答案；检验重放密钥，考察嫌疑模型是否偏好预测绿表词。二项检验的 p 值只对“模型记住水印”这一较窄主张给出确定的假阳性率。

作者在 Meta 的 meta-seal 仓库公开代码，但未发布独立打包的基准数据集、许可证或适用于闭源模型的通用检测器。关键数据对象是发布方持有的带水印基准及其秘密密钥。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Watermark questions. For each benchmark, choose a secret key and use Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct to rephrase each question. At every generation step, boost a keyed 50% green list; the paper tests strengths δ=0, 1, 2, and 4.
  1. Release and train. The provider releases the rephrased questions. For the controlled study, 1B transformers are trained from scratch on 10B DCLM tokens with zero, four, eight, or sixteen injected benchmark batches.
  1. Read radioactivity. With white-box access, forward each watermarked question through the suspect model, take its top-1 next-token predictions, reconstruct the keyed green list, and score unseen watermark windows once. Under no memorized watermark, the cumulative score follows a binomial distribution; its tail p-value is the decision statistic.
  1. Handle tokenizers and verify utility. When tokenizers differ, align equal text prefixes and score only shared-token predictions. Compare original and rephrased benchmark accuracy; reproduce with the exact key, rephrasing model, tokenizer, prompt template, δ, and model-access assumption. The repository does not disclose a standalone dataset license.

1. 给题目加水印。 每个基准选取秘密密钥，用 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 改写题目；每一步提高密钥决定的 50% 绿词表 logits。论文测试 δ=0、1、2、4。
  1. 发布并受控训练。 发布方公开改写后的题目。受控实验从头训练 1B Transformer，语料为 100 亿个 DCLM token，并注入 0、4、8 或 16 个基准批次。
  1. 读取放射性。 在可访问权重时，将带水印问题前向输入嫌疑模型，取 top-1 下一词预测，重建绿词表，并对未重复的水印窗口各计一次分。未记住水印时累计分服从二项分布，尾部 p 值即判决统计量。
  1. 处理分词器并核验效用。 分词器不同则对齐相同文本前缀，只评分共享词表预测；比较原题与改写题准确率。复现必须固定密钥、改写模型、分词器、提示模板、δ 和白盒访问假设；论文未披露独立数据集许可证。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Claim. Watermarked benchmarks retain useful evaluation behavior while the test detects contamination that materially inflates scores.

Controlled setting. The authors rephrase ARC-Easy, ARC-Challenge, and a 5,000-question MMLU subset, then pre-train 1B models on the same 10B-token DCLM stream while varying only injected watermarked benchmark batches. Table 1 uses δ=4 and an out-of-distribution question template.

Result. On MMLU, four contaminations raise accuracy by 5.1 points (30.6% to 35.7%) with log10(p)=−5.7; eight give +10.2 points with p<10⁻¹². With zero contamination, p-values are near 0.5. The paper also reports broadly similar rankings on original and rephrased ARC-Easy.

Boundary. This supports detection of memorized watermarks in these controlled, open-weight pre-training runs; it does not establish detection of every leak, causally prove score inflation for arbitrary deployed models, or protect against deliberate evasion.

主张。 带水印的基准仍可用于评测，同时统计检验能发现会实质抬高分数的污染。

受控设置。 作者改写 ARC-Easy、ARC-Challenge 和 5,000 题的 MMLU 子集；1B 模型均在相同的 100 亿 DCLM token 流上预训练，唯一变化是注入的带水印基准批次数。表 1 使用 δ=4 和分布外题目模板。

结果。 在 MMLU 上，4 次注入使准确率从 30.6% 升至 35.7%，增加 5.1 点，log10(p)=−5.7；8 次注入增加 10.2 点且 p<10⁻¹²。零注入时 p 值接近 0.5。原始与改写 ARC-Easy 的模型排序也大体一致。

边界。 这证明该检验能发现受控、开放权重预训练中的水印记忆；不能证明它能发现所有泄漏、归因任意部署模型的分数上升，或抵抗故意规避。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Post-hoc methods infer leaks from behavior or require a clean reference set; ordinary canaries are easy to remove or memorize weakly. This work moves the intervention before release: it watermarks question wording, then tests learned token bias with a p-value whose false-positive rate is defined for watermark memorization. It also adapts reading-mode radioactivity to mismatched tokenizers. The contribution is not generic decontamination: it needs a secret key and white-box model access.
事后方法从行为推断泄漏或依赖干净参照集，普通 canary 又容易被删除或记忆不足。本文把干预移到发布前：给题目措辞加水印，再以假阳性率已定义的 p 值检验学到的词级偏置，并适配分词器不一致的 reading-mode radioactivity。它并非通用去污染方案，而是依赖秘密密钥和白盒模型访问。

title: Limitations
局限
html: Rephrasing can damage individual-question coherence even when aggregate accuracy is similar, so providers should inspect item meaning. The design mainly addresses unintentional contamination: an adversary can rephrase away the signal or train only on answers. It tests memorized watermark radioactivity, not every exposure, and needs protected keys and white-box access. A reuse audit must therefore include adversarial and closed-model threat models; a nonsignificant result is not clearance.
即使总体准确率相近，改写仍会损害部分题目的连贯性，发布方应检查单题语义。设计主要应对非故意污染：对手可再次改写削弱信号，或只训练答案。它检验记住水印的放射性而非所有暴露，且需要密钥保护和白盒访问。复用审计必须覆盖对抗者和闭源模型；不显著结果不是无污染证明。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: A benchmark maintainer can rephrase questions under a per-benchmark key, retain the key, and run reading-mode scoring on an open-weight submission. The output is a calibrated contamination report beside accuracy; success requires preserved item utility and interpretation under the stated null. Do not use it as a black-box audit, after a benchmark has leaked, or without key management and human review of rephrases.
基准维护者可用每个基准独立的密钥改写题目、保留密钥，再对开放权重提交模型运行 reading-mode 评分。输出是与准确率并列的校准污染报告；成功条件是单题效用仍被保留，并在既定零假设下解释结果。模型为黑盒、基准已经泄漏，或无法管理密钥和人工复核改写时，不应直接采用。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Position. It turns contamination auditing into pre-release keyed watermarking.
  2. Mechanism. Rephrase with a green-list bias, then score top-1 predictions against the replayed key.
  3. Artifact. meta-seal supplies code; the paper does not establish a separately packaged data release or license.
  4. Evidence. In the 1B/10B-token MMLU control, four injections yield +5.1 points and log10(p)=−5.7; this is not a deployed-model result.
  5. Reuse. Use before release with open-weight access; first check semantic equivalence and evasive-training risk.

1. 定位。 它将污染审计变为发布前的密钥水印。
  2. 方法抓手。 以绿词表偏置改写，再按重放密钥对 top-1 预测评分。
  3. Artifact。 meta-seal 提供代码；论文未确认独立数据发布或许可证。
  4. 证据锚点。 1B/100 亿 token 的 MMLU 对照中，4 次注入带来 5.1 点提升且 log10(p)=−5.7；这不是部署模型结果。
  5. 复用决定。 适合发布前且可访问开放权重；先查语义等价与规避式训练风险。
